title: The Diamond Sutra, oldest dated printed book, is made
summary: A woodblock printed copy of the Buddhist Diamond Sutra was produced in Tang China, with a note giving this date. It was found in the Mogao Caves at Dunhuang in 1900.
reason: A man named Wang Jie paid for the printing for the merit of his parents, as Buddhists spread scripture through copies.
significance: It is the earliest dated printed book known, evidence of the Chinese invention of printing.
